content.what_it_is: MATLAB function Zero_Coherence_Spectrum (L1-2, no inputs; loads workspace variables from inputs.mat at L4) that builds a directional TMA-type wave spectrum with zero coherence for the FUNWAVE-TVD WKDATA2D wavemaker. Frequency section (L6-28): uniform frequency grid from fmin to fmax with mfreq bins (L7,L10); Kitaigorodskii depth factor phi from nondimensional omiga_spec=2*pi*f*sqrt(depth/g) (L11-17: phi=0.5*omiga^2 for omiga<=1, 1-0.5*(2-omiga)^2 in between, 1 for omiga>=2); JONSWAP sigma switch 0.09/0.07 above/below fp (L18-22); TMA spectral density Etma(kf) with g^2 f^-5 (2pi)^-4 base, exp(-5/4 (f/fp)^-4) and gamma_spec peak enhancement (L24-25); per-bin energy and running total (L26-27). Directional section (L29-54): N_spec=20/sigma_theta (L30); the frequency grid is shifted by the offset diff so fp lands exactly on a component (L32-33); idx_theta from mod(displace_theta,mtheta) (L35-36); each frequency component gets one direction theta(kf) via an alternating-sign fan over [-pi/2,pi/2] (L42-44), snapped to 0.1-degree resolution and offset by theta_mean (L45), converted back to radians (L46); wrapped-normal directional weight AG(kf) as truncated cosine series with exp(-0.5*(k_n*sigma_theta)^2) coefficients (L48-52), then abs (L53). Host frequencies are every mtheta-th index starting at idx_theta, forced to include mfreq (L55-62). Calibration (L63-71): alpha_spec=Hmo^2/16/Energy_total (L64), correction_coeff rescales AG so sum(AG.*EnergyBin) equals Energy_total (L65,L67), per-component wave height Hmo_each(kf)=4*sqrt(alpha_spec*EnergyBin*AG) (L68) and Spectrum_Energy(kf) (L69). Hs_output check value at L73. reps=ones(1,mfreq) (L77) because with no coherence each frequency appears once. Lines 78-91 are blank.

io.name: inputs.mat (provides fmax,fmin,mfreq,depth,g,fp,gamma_spec,sigma_theta,theta_mean,Hmo,mtheta used but not defined in this file)

verbatim_spans.text: % lock fp and thetamean to a component
% in new wavemaker with no coherence it is equal to zero

unresolved: All physical inputs (fmax,fmin,mfreq,mtheta,depth,g,fp,gamma_spec,sigma_theta,theta_mean,Hmo) come from inputs.mat (L4) whose contents are not visible in this file

L32 assigns scalar offset to variable named diff (shadows MATLAB builtin diff); L33 freq=freq+diff shifts the whole grid by the fp mismatch, so the actual grid no longer starts exactly at fmin (relation L7/L10 vs L32-33)
theta_mean is added in degrees at L45 but multiplied by pi/180 at L51 inside the AG series while theta(kf) at that point is already in radians (L46) — mixed unit handling across L45/L46/L51
N_spec=20/sigma_theta (L30) may be non-integer yet is used as for-loop upper bound at L49
Hs_output (L73) is computed but is not among the function outputs (L1-2) and is not otherwise used
host_freqs_idx first-element check compares against 0 (L57) although idx_theta:mtheta:mfreq starting value 0 can only occur when idx_theta==0 (L36,L56)
